conditions.description: The conditions that hold now, such as HighLoad. A condition that does not hold is not in the list.

type.description: A condition that an agent or a component evaluates.
type.title: ConditionType

config_behind.description: The agent has not applied the newest config that the controller holds for it yet: it applies it at its next heartbeat, or it cannot reach the controller's config.

config_version.description: The version of the controller's config of the agent that the agent applied. Absent when it applied none.

config_wanted.description: The version of the config that the controller holds for the agent. Absent when it holds none.

controller_key.description: The fingerprint of the controller key that the agent verifies jobs with.

controller_key_next.description: The fingerprint of the key that the controller switches to, which the agent has: empty when no rotation of the controller's key is in progress, or the agent has not taken it yet.

fingerprint.description: The SHA256 fingerprint of the agent's PKI public key. Empty until the agent loads its keys.

family.description: AddressFamily is the IP address family of an interface.
family.title: AddressFamily

key_stored.description: Whether the controller holds this agent's public key, recorded when its enrollment was accepted. False for an agent that has not enrolled since the key store existed, which is what to re-enrol before enabling enforcement.

labels.description: Key-value labels configured on the agent.

load_average.description: The system load averages for 1, 5, and 15 minutes.

1min.description: Load average for the last 1 minute.

5min.description: Load average for the last 5 minutes.

15min.description: Load average for the last 15 minutes.

load_average.title: LoadAverageResponse

missing_programs.description: The programs that the agent's behaviors declare and that the host lacks. A behavior fails until its program is installed.

nats_cert_next.description: The fingerprint of the NATS server's next certificate, which the agent trusts during a rotation of it.

distribution.description: The name of the Linux distribution.

family.description: The platform family that the agent picks providers by, as gohai names it: debian, suse, darwin and so on. A method runs on a host whose family is one of its platforms.

version.description: The version of the Linux distribution.

primary_interface.description: Name of the interface used for the default route.

registered_at.description: When the agent last refreshed its heartbeat.

state.description: The scheduling state of an agent: Ready, Draining, Cordoned or Pending. A drain that the agent has not applied yet is Draining.
state.title: AgentState

verified.description: Whether this agent's registration was signed by its stored key and claims the hostname it enrolled under. Only a verified registration decides where work is routed. True when the controller is not enforcing verification.

version.description: The build version of the agent binary. Absent for an agent that does not report it.

error.description: A description of the error that occurred.

reason.description: Why the request failed, as a word that a program can branch on. The HTTP status is the class of the problem; the reason is the cause, and the error is the message for a person, which can change between releases. invalid_request: the request breaks a rule, such as a missing field (400). unauthorized: no token, or a token that is not valid (401). forbidden: the token does not have the permission (403). not_found: the host or osapi does not have what the request names (404). not_managed: the item is there, but osapi did not deploy it, so osapi does not change it (409). not_installed: the host does not have a program that the request needs (409). conflict: the state of the item blocks the request, such as a create of one that exists (409). unavailable: a part that osapi depends on is down, such as NATS (503). server_error: the controller failed; its log has the cause (500).
